Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Akanksha1809
Message:
Phase 7: dashboard UI, postmortem generator, reports

Postmortem generation is pure Markdown assembly from already-stored facts
(timeline, evidence, investigation hypotheses, remediation history) - never a
new AI call. Section markers let a regenerate rebuild the generated sections
while preserving human-authored ones (Lessons Learned, Follow-ups) verbatim.

The web UI is server-rendered Jinja2 with session-cookie auth, separate from
the JSON API's Bearer tokens. Deviates from the original htmx plan: no
client-side JavaScript at all, since vendoring a third-party JS file had no
safe path in this environment and a CSRF header needs JS to set it. CSRF uses
the Synchronizer Token Pattern (hidden form field, HMAC over the session
cookie) instead, and the CSP ships as script-src 'none' - stricter than
planned. See docs/threat-model.md T5/T14 for the full reasoning.

Verified live against the real running stack: migration 0005 applied,
sentinel-api/worker redeployed, logged into the UI and generated a real
postmortem for INC-0011 (the Phase 6 exit-criterion incident), confirmed in
the live audit log and via the API.

496 tests passing (72 new this phase), lint/mypy/bandit/pip-audit clean.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Akanksha1809
Message:
Phase 4: evidence gathering from metrics, logs and change history

- Prometheus/Loki clients: timeouts, bounded retries (5xx/transport only),
  5 MB response cap, series caps
- Code-owned query templates; the only variable is fullmatch-validated and
  escaped. Loki queries select on the indexed level label (| json timed out)
- Log sanitiser: control-char stripping, secret/PII redaction, prompt-
  injection flagging (kept as data)
- Deterministic derived signals: onset via step-change detection, change
  correlation (time proximity, 5xx share, error-log share) with reasons;
  rollbacks are not cause candidates
- Evidence collections/items (migration 0002, immutable for the app role);
  failed queries recorded as data gaps (partial status)
- sentinel-worker: deduplicated evidence.collect jobs on incident
  open/reopen/new alert and on refresh; worker metrics + alerts

Security fix: validators used re.match with $, which accepts a trailing
newline; all switched to fullmatch with regression tests.

Verified live: broken deploy -> INC-0002 -> evidence collected
automatically 17s later; top change candidate PR-143 scored 0.97.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Akanksha1809
Message:
Phase 2: target system, guarded actuator, monitoring stack

- shop-api demo service: RED metrics, JSON logs, deterministic faults
  (broken release 1.1.0, crash-looping config r2, bounded chaos endpoints)
- actuator: catalogue-allowlisted deploy/rollback/restart/scale, idempotent,
  dry-run, fleet metrics, Prometheus http_sd, deployment history
- docker-guard: Docker API admission controller. Added after a live probe
  showed the path-only socket proxy admits privileged container creation
- loadgen: seeded fixed-rate traffic
- Compose stack: Prometheus SLI/burn-rate rules, Alertmanager, Loki + Alloy,
  Grafana dashboard, Postgres, two restricted socket proxies
- Policy tests for Compose security invariants, promtool rule tests, CI

Verified live: scenarios A/B/C each fired the expected alert and recovered
after remediation through the actuator (timings in docs/architecture.md).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
